horoscopes.horoscope: Today is an ordinary day, it is business as usual, but there will be some progress. You can while away your time doing petty chores. And, Ganesha says, while day-dreaming think about that coveted home, as that’s how the first plans materialise. Your love life may not be good today, feels Ganesha. You may be less emotional and more pragmatic so your lover may find it very strange and different. This behaviour is going to impact the equation between both of you today. Ganesha suggests you to control mood swings today. From health point of view, the day looks average. Your emotional barometer will be directly connected with your health today, says Ganesha. On the whole, this could be called ‘handle with care’ day. If you are in a job, chances of you finding another job opportunity will increase, which will also include financial growth. Alternatively, there will be possibility of you getting news about salary hike. You may remain practical,calculative and analytical at workplace today.This can help you in handling the routine work however, Ganesha suggests you not to refrain from taking responsibilities.Your nature today suits you to routine work but not to taking responsibility.

Feel your imagination run wild as you star-gaze throughout the day wondering about the existence of the extra terrestrial. You will paint the workplace in your flavour of innovation, combined with a drive to work equally hard. Add some smooth talk to the equation and you will find a lot of people in awe of your charm, says Ganesha. Lovers may remain practical in their approach towards matters related to heart. Your life partner or beloved may feel that you are unable to express emotions in right manner. This is going to impact your love life today, feels Ganesha. You will be able to handle your routine pretty well today. Creative energy will be at peak so you will find yourself in good mood. You will be willing to do some planning. It’s a good day to plan your routine. If you have not yet invested in the stock market, this is the right day to do so. As fortune is in your favour, you will be able to add some money to your account today. Ganesha finds you very decisive and confident today. This is going to increase your speed and make you more efficient, feels Ganesha. You will be able to judge things well in advance which will help you quicken up routine office-work.

Today, you may encounter unusual challenges, says Ganesha. You will come up with new thoughts and tactics, which will bring about positive changes and results. Avoid any confrontation with those living around you. Ganesha advises you to keep your cool during the day. The day would be good for you from love life point of view, feels Ganesha. You may wish to spend good time with your beloved one and if you are unmarried, desire to get engaged or marry would be high. Today your energy will be focussed on balancing between personal and professional fronts. You will be in demand at both the ends thus it will lead to stressful mental situation. You will feel worried about addressing certain issues related to family. Ganesha feels that today you will be seeing more gain in property so you might want to go and see some apartments or shops. By and large, your investment related decisions are going to benefit you. Your power to negotiate with others may be little low today, hence you are advised not to arrange very important meetings today. Even if the superiors are not favourably disposed to you, it would be better not to be disappointed.

Financially, you may be in a bit of a bother today. Payment of bills, taxes and loans may keep you busy for most part of the day. You may even contemplate borrowing money to meet the demands. However, you are likely to receive one of your pending payments, which will be enough to get you out of the fix. Also, a courageous business manoeuvre may pay rich dividends, says Ganesha. The day will find you in good talks with your loved one or partner. Ganesha finds you enjoying intellectual and interesting conversations with spouse or beloved. This is going to make you happy and feel good. You are going to enjoy it. From health point of view, it’s not a bad day at all. Your mind will be pretty active and energy will be completely focussed. You will be having various ideas coming in your mind and now you will need to start implementing them. Ganesha feels that today you will be in the dilemma about money matters. Your heart will say something and logic will differ with the same. You will have to start thinking differently. You may be in a mood to criticise others at workplace, which may lead you to get into conflicts with everyone else. You are suggested to take care of this point. You are advised to avoid being to judgemental while talking to colleagues.

Being good to oneself is not vanity. To Ganesha, it seems as if you take this statement to heart, since it looks quite possible that you make your personal care number one priority today. On the flip side though, you become aware of the fact that the harder you try the more it seems you have to. But all that should be the least of your concerns today; just remember to take time out to entertain yourself and recharge your batteries. This will go a long way in keeping you going for the future, says Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bright Yellow You have to be careful about criticising too much. Ganesha feels that you should ensure that over-criticism doesn’t hurt your beloved one or spouse, warns Ganesha.It is going to affect your love life if you don’t pay much attention to it. You may be affected by emotional disturbances, which could impact your health. Ganesha asks you to guard against such disturbances. You are also suggested to maintain good and balanced diet even though you may be offered good food today. You will not be unhappy with anything. Others are likely to contribute to your finances. Family’s financial strength is going to increases. You will be thankful to the Lord for the comforts and financial bliss. You may be very verbal while at work so Ganesha finds you giving suggestions to everyone around you. Ensure that you are not hurt if your suggestions are not accepted by others with due grace. You will be alert for your duties.

The time today is ripe to venture into a new business. Projects that have been put-off will finally be completed. Looking into the week ahead, you are most likely to give yourself an energy zap. Parties will be all fun and entertainment. Your kids will bring home joy and pride and this will brighten the mood even more, says Ganesha. Lovers may enjoy each others company and may take some practical decisions about the love life. This enjoyment of mutual company will make you feel good, feels Ganesha. Besides, the practical decisions which you take today too could be important. The day indicates that you will be operating at good energy level today. You will be very passionate about things that you wish to do in life. Your mental outlook will be so good that you will be able to handle many things. Ganesha feels that today you are likely to be very calculative, logical and analytical. There will be strong desire to organize things in life and as a result to which, you will also be working on your finances. You may be very energetic and highly practical today. Try to make the best out of this day. You can use the day to your advantage. It is the most favourable day to plan or begin new projects. It holds lot of potential for you.

The Bhagavad Gita says, “Do your duty without expecting the fruit.” Remember this important lesson and strive hard to put in extra efforts to finish off whatever you undertake to do. Worrying about results will only hamper your progress. Go with the flow and let results come to you. You may want to discuss some urgent matters with your close friend today, says Ganesha. You may find yourself short of time. You may not find it for your loved one or partner. Ganesha feels you may hardly have time for lover or life partner which may make your beloved feel a little bad. This could be difficult for you. Your analytical skills will come out today. This is going to make you help solve various types of problems. There could be more problems. But you need not get upset due to these problems. You can face them step by step. It’s a good day to go for full body check up and figure out what all kind of medicine you need to eat. You can also change your diet plan today in order to remain hale and hearty. Remember health is wealth. Ganesha finds you investing time in problem solving today at workplace. Your capacity to solve everything is generally good being a Libran but today you may feel frustrated as you may not be able to find solutions of some burning issues.

At work, you would want to change the perspective with which people see you. Your colleagues recognise you as the emerging alpha-lion. Ideas and opinions will impress your bosses. But keep a level head and learn where to stop when winning, counsels Ganesha. This day demands that you should give importance to your beloved or spouse. If you let your lover or spouse decide how to spend evening together, he or she may feel much valued, says Ganesha. This way you will be happier. The day will be good for you. You will be in a good mood which will help you attend long-pending issues, says Ganesha. You will be very fast in everything. Your good mood will be supplemented by helpful people around you. Hard work that you have been putting in, will now start repaying you good rewards. This is a good day to discuss finer financial aspects with a friend. You should also be able to have some gains through friends. Your colleagues will be favourably disposed today. This is going to be of help to you as you will finish off routine office work very fast. Support from superiors may also encourage you to take a call on something which was pending since long.

Going to private parties is a high probability today. All in all, make the most of it as you get nostalgic with old friends and make plans with new ones. Moreover, relatives will be pleased to meet you after a long time. Even while you may be in the company of the beloved, you may be busy working.You need to pay attention to your partner as well, feels Ganesha. Ganesha advises you to ensure that such behaviour doesn’t make your partner feel ignored. You will be highly practical in your mood today. This will help you solve various types of problems like completing your pending work. You will be able to do meet several deadlines by virtue of your good mood, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today you are likely to be more action oriented in your work. This will surely help earn good money. Today’s hard work is investment for a better tomorrow. It’s best day to draw plan for the next week or month. You may use a scheduler or organizer so that you don’t miss out on appointments and small details of the plans during next few days. You need to be careful about that.

Whether you’re an artist, performer, professional or an entrepreneur, career issues will take the foreground today, while personal matters will wait in queue for your attention, says Ganesha. Your performance will be at its all-time high, and your efforts will be duly rewarded, but credit for this must go to your loved ones who will lend their unceasing support for all your endeavours. Your love life will be good today, feels Ganesha. You may be able to devote due time and attention to love life, which will keep your mate’s heartbeats in control. All this is going to make you happy and feel good about it. You will be in a positive mood today. This is going to help you in several ways, feels Ganesha. It will help you in various meetings and other social interactions. You will feel happy and good about all these developments. You will be careful with spending and more alert about earning sources. You will try to tap your contacts to get better or more work. If you are in job, you are sure to progress well in the nearer future. Even though you may depend a great deal on luck factor, today you will be in a mood to give due importance to other people’s opinions. Ganesha finds you calling for or attending important meetings, which may be for future development.

Aim. Shoot. Achieve. Today, you will concentrate your energies to execute your plans with precision. Naturally, your work progresses by leaps and bounds. By sundown, you will achieve far more than everyone’s estimation. That’s the way to go, says Ganesha. By evening you may be so tired that you will not be able to devote much time to personal life. You have to take care of your loved one or partner. Ensure that your beloved one’s emotional barometer remains in control despite such a situation. You will be in a good mood and dynamic in your mental health, says Ganesha. Today, you’ll not only need to make a list of social and official obligations but also fulfill them. You may find solution to a pending problem by your dynamism. Ganesha finds this to be a dull day for money matters. You are not going to make big sum today. Even if you try your luck in speculative market or gambling, you are most likely to fail. Today you might have to spend more hours at workplace just to finish off your routine work. Thus, you may be more involved in your work today, feels Ganesha. In other words, it may be a long day for you.

Of late, the harder you try, the more it seems you have to do. You are likely to put your foot down today and spend some time taking care of yourself and playing truant with your responsibilities. Recharge your batteries fully while you are at it, says Ganesha. In personal relationships, the day should be about avoiding criticisement, feels Ganesha. You may not face big problems provided you avoid criticising the ones you love the most. This is important if you want to avoid problems and make the situation easier. Whether at home or in the office, you will consider others’ views today. You are slightly more emotional than others and tend to take things to your heart. However, today you need to take criticism constructively. You will enjoy your day a lot. Ganesha feels that today you will be spending fortune on near ones and dear ones. As it is, you like to spend money. You will be able to spend good sum on people you like. People around you at the workplace may be bit apprehensive about your method of working. You may feel that everyone is opposing you or trying to cross you. If you handle everything with due tact, there won’t be any issue, feels Ganesha.
